issues: 完整标题落定后只 hold 15 帧（0.5s）就淡出，观众来不及读完（违反 R1）
黑场是一块平涂 #0c0c10，字卡段没有任何空间氛围，像黑屏
逐词压印按等差 3f 起跑，节奏机械
等宽副行只有 20px（约 1.9% 帧高），处于「想让人读但读不清」的中间态
前镜原地熄灯、字卡原地淡出，镜与镜之间没有运动惯性
changes: 时间轴重排（总长 120f 不变）：字卡 14–44f 压印完，完整标题 hold 30f（1s）再退场，字卡退净后 B 才淡入，不叠化
暗场改为带色相深底 + 字卡后一团极淡暖光（6–20f 缓亮）+ 暗角 + 颗粒，still alive 但不抢字
逐词起跑改为缓动分布（前紧后松，14→32f），每词 snappy 缓动下沉 0.12em + scale 1.14→1 + 6px→0 失焦收清
副行提到 28px 等宽、0.18em 字距并随细线一起上浮淡入；强调色细线改 2px 两端渐隐、从中心 snappy 展开
A 淡出时延续前镜推进惯性轻推 2.5%；字卡退场上浮 14px + 微糊（ease-in）；B 从 1.03 轻收落定
issuesEn: The full headline held for only 15 frames (0.5s) before fading — too short to read (violates R1)
The black field was a flat #0c0c10 with no atmosphere during the card — it read as a dead screen
Word stamps started on an even 3f cadence, which felt mechanical
The mono subline was only 20px (~1.9% of frame height), stuck in the 'meant to be read but can't be' middle state
The outgoing shot just switched off and the card faded in place — no carried motion between shots
changesEn: Retimed within the same 120f: words finish stamping by 44f, the full headline holds 30f (1s), and B fades in only after the card has fully cleared — no cross-dissolve
The dark field now has a hue-tinted base, a faint warm glow behind the card (eases up 6–20f), vignette and grain — alive without competing with the type
Word starts follow an eased distribution (tight first, looser last, 14→32f); each word drops 0.12em with a snappy ease while scaling 1.14→1 and focusing from 6px blur
Subline raised to 28px mono with 0.18em tracking, rising in with the rule; the accent rule is now 2px with faded ends, unfolding from center
A carries the previous shot's push (+2.5%) as it fades; the card exits rising 14px with a slight blur (ease-in); B settles in from scale 1.03
